# WO-2026-08-12-05 — Prove the instrument, then measure the spread. No architecture changes.

## Acceptance criteria

> **⛔ WARWICK'S FRAMING, AND IT GOVERNS EVERY LINE BELOW.** *"Current direction is correct. Do NOT change
> architecture again yet. The latest result does NOT justify another prompt round, another heuristic,
> another region redesign, or another Work Order. **We now have a measurement problem first.**"*
> **This order changes NOTHING about how the system works. It establishes whether what we have measured is real.**

**AC1 — THE FREE FIXTURE SANITY CHECK. Do it FIRST, before spending a cent.**

*"Establish that the ground-truth instrument itself is internally coherent and that the scorer is grading
the intended properties. Do not let another stale/noisy instrument drive engineering decisions."*

This is the 38-line check left undone in WP-B15-31. It needs no gateway. Establish and report:
- every fixture line is internally coherent — `source_text`, `catalogue_product`, `expected_quantity` and
  any `contested` marker agree with each other and with the household ruling that an unmarked line means 1;
- the scorer grades the property each metric CLAIMS to grade — in particular that
  `leadingCountPreservationPct` measures the fault and not its overlap with the default, and that the
  contested-line exclusion is **printed beside** the number and never folded into it;
- any line whose expected identity is not carried by the 109-item catalogue is reported as such rather than
  silently graded;
- **anything that looks wrong is REPORTED, not corrected mid-flight** unless leaving it would make the three
  runs unmeasurable — and if you do correct something, it happens **entirely before run 1** and is stated.

**AC2 — ⛔ THREE IDENTICAL RUNS. THIS IS THE LOAD-BEARING CONSTRAINT OF THE WHOLE ORDER.**

*"Same code. Same image. Same catalogue. Same prompt/schema. Same image-prep path. Same reconciliation.
**No architectural changes between runs.**"*

> **⛔⛔ IF RUN 1 EXPOSES A DEFECT, DO NOT FIX IT BEFORE RUNS 2 AND 3.** Warwick, verbatim: *"Complete the
> three identical runs first. Otherwise we learn nothing about variance because the system changes
> underneath the experiment."*
>
> **This will feel wrong. A defect will surface and every instinct will say fix it now. Do not.** A fix
> between runs destroys the only thing this order produces. Record it, finish the three runs, then report it.

**Prove the runs were identical rather than asserting it:** record the commit SHA before run 1 and after
run 3 and show it did not move; record that the working tree was clean at both points; record the identical
invocation for all three.

**AC3 — REPORT EACH RUN SEPARATELY, THEN THE SPREAD. ⛔ DO NOT AVERAGE AWAY BAD BEHAVIOUR.**

*"Do not give Warwick one flattering mean percentage. Show the actual three runs."* Averages may follow;
**the raw spread is the decision-grade output.**

Per run, both layers:
**PHOTO / SOURCE TRUTH** — detected · omitted · invented PHOTO lines · duplicates · explicit quantity
preserved · quantity errors · UNKNOWNs.
**IDENTITY** — correct catalogue identity · wrong identity · unresolved.
Plus **calls · wall time · actual cost** per run.

**AC4 — ANSWER THE FOUR QUESTIONS THE SPREAD EXISTS TO ANSWER**, by name, with the evidence:
1. **Is 39/39 detection stable**, or does it move?
2. **Do inventions recur RANDOMLY or SYSTEMATICALLY** — the same phantom products each time, or different ones?
3. **Do duplicates recur in the SAME PLACES?**
4. **Do digit errors recur on the SAME quantities?** (WP-B15-31 saw page `3`→`2`, `4`→`1`, `1`→`7`.)
**A defect that recurs identically is deterministic and fixable. One that moves is the mechanism being
unstable.** That distinction is the entire product of this order.

**AC5 — THE VERDICT WARWICK HAS PRE-COMMITTED TO. State which case you are in, plainly.**
- **≈ 39/39, 38/39, 39/39** with near-zero invention, narrow repeatable quantity defects and stable identity
  → *"the eyesight architecture is effectively established and the remaining defects are narrow
  deterministic/reconciliation work."*
- **≈ 39/39, 32/39, 36/39**, or inventions varying wildly → *"the vision mechanism itself is not stable
  enough and we stop calling it polishing."*
**Do not soften a bad spread into a good one, and do not oversell a good one.**

**AC6 — DO NOT REGRESS WHAT SURVIVES.** Warwick's list, untouched during the measurement: correct
reading-axis handling · application-owned regions · genuine 3× enlargement · strict closed candidate set ·
UNKNOWN allowed · free brand invention structurally blocked · household context retained · quantity field
explicitly required · pack-size separated from purchase quantity · source truth separated from catalogue
identity · the completed production image-prep integration. **Do not touch these during the variance run.**

**AC7 — PROJECT THE COST BEFORE THE FIRST RUN, then measure it.** Ceiling **$1.50** for all three runs.
⚠️ **WP-B15-31 breached its ceiling ($0.4317 against $0.35) and its own diagnosis was that it did not
project the run cost before spending** — `leading_mark` added output tokens across seven bands and the run
came in 42% above the rate budgeted from. **State your projection before run 1 and your actual after run 3.**
If run 1 lands materially above projection, **say so and continue** — three runs is the deliverable, not
three cheap runs.

**AC8 — PRESERVE ALL ARTEFACTS.** Every run's raw output and score committed under `runs/`. Warwick:
*"Preserve all artefacts."* These are the evidence base for whatever is decided next.

**⛔ ACCEPTANCE IS NOT CLAIMED BY THIS ORDER, AND WARWICK HAS WRITTEN THE HONEST STATE:** *"eyesight
mechanism looks very promising; identity resolution looks strong; quantity preservation is materially
improved but imperfect; duplicate reconciliation still has real defects; household catalogue items can
still appear as PHOTO when absent; the integrated production path has not yet been exercised by a real
production photograph. **Capability is not live proof.**"* Do not write a sentence that implies otherwise.

## Required evidence

- Both suites, executed, asserting **reported counts** and naming them — never exit codes alone. Baselines at `54e1743`: package **920 / 917 pass / 0 fail / 3 skipped**; prototype **218/218/0/0**. **These must not move** — this order changes no behaviour.
- **AC2 identity proof**: the commit SHA before run 1 and after run 3, shown unmoved, with a clean working tree at both points, and the identical invocation recorded for all three runs.
- **Three run artefacts** committed under `runs/`, each with its own full two-layer score.
- **The spread table** — three rows, no mean substituted for them.
- `bash scripts/secret-scan.sh` over the authored paths → exit code AND coverage. Exit 2 is NOT SCANNED, never a pass. (The `--surface services/asdair/pipeline` form still cannot exit 0 — vendor trees under `node_modules` — which is a known order-side defect, reported not fixed.)
- `bash scripts/secret-scan.sh --surface services/asdair/pipeline` → report exit code AND coverage. Exit 2 is NOT SCANNED, never a pass

## Inputs supplied

- `Deliverables/2026-08-04-build-015-asdair-wayfinder-plan.md` § **⟦ACTIVE SESSION WORK PACKAGE⟧** — Warwick's variance directive in full, and § "THE MEASUREMENT PROBLEM UNDERNEATH EVERY NUMBER IN THIS BUILD". **The authority and the premise for this order.**
- **Your own branch at `54e1743`** — the final arm as it stands. `lineSchema.js` (with `leading_mark`), `bandInspection.js`, `quantityRule.js`, `groundLines.js`, `imagePrep.js` (canonical planner), `bandPlan.js` (pure re-export), `sevenWayScore.js`, the fixture under `fixtures/`, and `runs/rescore-all-arms.mjs`.
- The five re-scored arm artefacts under `runs/`, with their `twoLayerScore_SUPERSEDED` blocks retained.
- The real household catalogue via `loadCatalogue.js`, household ID **1**, **109 active regulars**.
- **The photograph** — the only private-surface input, read-only.

## Explicitly out of scope — report, never fix

- ⛔ **EVERY architectural change.** No prompt round, no new heuristic, no region redesign, no model switch, no schema change, no threshold tuning. Warwick has ruled this out by name. **If you find yourself editing behaviour, you have left the order.**
- ⛔ **Fixing anything a run exposes, before all three runs are complete.** See AC2. This is the single easiest way to destroy this experiment.
- **Cost optimisation.** Measure only.
- **Any database WRITE**, migration or DDL. SELECT-only.
- **Four-way provenance persistence** — still absent by design. Report, do not build.
- **The 3 inventions, the 2 duplicates, the misread digits.** They are the SUBJECT of the measurement, not the target of a fix. Characterise them; do not repair them.
- **`abAcceptanceHarness.js`'s 41-line trolley** · **`applyVisionConfidenceGate`'s `Number(null)===0`** · **the secret scanner's vendor-tree blindness** · **GL-012 shape divergence** · **`deps.js`'s `realInterpretPhoto` having no executed test**. All REPORT-ONLY.
- **Governance side-issues** — the Veritas receipt SHA mismatch and Larry's held-commit branch discipline. Warwick: *"not allowed to consume the vision frontier tonight unless they actively invalidate the experiment."* They do not. Ignore them.

## Sequencing

**0. READ-BACK, then HOLD.** Outcome, plan, what the order failed to settle, what looks wrong — then stop
and wait for Larry's acceptance. **Four consecutive read-backs on this build have found genuine defects in
Larry's orders and all four were upheld in full**, including one that showed the ordered region geometry
would have made the result worse, and one that found the reported baseline was stale-instrument output.
**Apply the same scrutiny — it has been the single most valuable control in this build.**

**1. AC1 — the free fixture sanity check. Before any spend.** If it reveals the instrument is wrong, that
is a stop-and-report, not something to fix and press on through.

**2. AC7 — project the cost.** Before run 1, on the record.

**3. AC2 — the three runs. Nothing changes between them.** Record the SHA and tree state before run 1 and
after run 3. **If run 1 exposes something alarming, note it and run 2 anyway.**

**4. AC3 → AC4 → AC5** — the per-run reports, the spread, the four questions, and the plain verdict on
which of Warwick's two cases you are in.

**Git endpoint: COMMIT and PUSH the branch** — `git push origin HEAD:build-015/b15-28-agentic-vision-prototype-v2`.
**NO PR.** Work from `54e1743`; do not merge `main`.

**Return to Larry** with: the sanity-check result, the three runs reported separately, the spread, the four
answers, your AC5 verdict, cost projected vs actual, and your HEAD SHA. **The deliverable is the EVIDENCE,
not a good score.** A spread showing the mechanism is unstable is a completely successful discharge of this
order — arguably the more valuable one, because it stops us polishing something that will not hold.
